display_semantics.note: S3 ADD/TRIM expresses current recommendation intent. It does not prove that the recommendation episode remains unexecuted; Phase3 is authoritative for validated quantities and repeat-action suppression.

catalysts: Net interest margin stabilizes as deposit costs reprice lower.
NPL ratio and provision coverage remain stable while problem-loan migration improves.
Core Tier-1 capital remains above current levels and supports measured balance-sheet growth.
Dividend distributions remain sustainable without weakening capital.
kill_thesis: NPL formation or migration deteriorates materially, especially in concentrated regional or property-related exposures.
Provision coverage falls sharply or credit costs consume normalized earnings.
Net interest margin continues structural compression without offsetting fee or volume growth.
Core Tier-1 capital falls toward a level that constrains growth or shareholder distributions.

catalysts: Core PCB gross margin recovers materially as copper/CCL/gold-salt cost increases are passed through and low-margin orders are exited.
IC-substrate and high-multilayer/server mix continues to rise while generating measurable company-level profit rather than only revenue growth.
Zhuhai phase-2 utilization improves enough to absorb fixed cost and Thailand capacity ramps with credible customer commitments and ROIC.
Operating cash flow remains strong while earnings recover, confirming that the margin improvement is cash-backed.
kill_thesis: Core PCB gross margin remains in the high-single-digit area or deteriorates despite structural price increases.
AI-server related PCB remains a small share of revenue while the equity continues to price a much larger AI earnings contribution.
Raw-material inflation, FX or inventory write-downs continue to offset product-mix improvement.
New capacity and overseas expansion consume capital without producing acceptable incremental ROIC or free-cash-flow conversion.
A sustained valuation premium remains unsupported by normalized EPS upgrades.

catalysts: FX losses normalize or are better contained through pricing and hedging, allowing revenue growth to translate into profit growth.
Light-conveyor domestic margin improvement persists as automation/logistics demand and high-value products scale.
Operating cash conversion normalizes after tax-prepayment and working-capital timing effects.
The Kunshan intelligent-transmission project ramps toward 2027 commissioning with credible returns on capital.
kill_thesis: Operating cash flow remains materially below normalized profit after temporary tax and working-capital effects reverse.
Precision-molding margins continue to decline even after FX normalization.
Kunshan or other expansion capex fails to produce acceptable ROIC or materially weakens the balance sheet.
The high shareholder payout proves unsustainable as growth capex and working capital rise.

catalysts: New waste-to-energy projects and acquired capacity ramp on schedule with stable utilization.
Grid-power output and industrial heat sales continue to grow faster than waste tonnage through efficiency gains.
Convertible-funded projects earn returns above the incremental funding cost while leverage stabilizes.
Operating cash conversion remains above normalized earnings and the 60%+ payout framework is maintained.
kill_thesis: Project commissioning or utilization materially misses plan, reducing the expected 2027 earnings step-up.
Waste-treatment fees, power tariffs or subsidy collection deteriorate materially.
Receivables, debt and capex rise faster than operating cash generation for a sustained period.
Convertible financing creates dilution without a corresponding ROIC uplift.
Core waste-treatment margin or cash conversion deteriorates enough to negate the defensive-quality thesis.

catalysts: New multipurpose/pulp and auto-carrier capacity continues converting into revenue without margin dilution.
Special-shipping TCE stays above the 2025 run-rate and high-value equipment/auto exports remain resilient.
Semi-submersible/offshore-wind project pipeline exits the current project-window softness.
Fleet expansion is funded without material deterioration in balance-sheet quality or cash conversion.
kill_thesis: Normalized attributable earnings fall below roughly RMB2.0bn without a temporary explanation.
Fleet TCE and gross margin decline together while leased-capacity costs remain elevated.
Auto-export or high-value equipment demand normalizes faster than new fleet capacity can be absorbed.
Operating cash flow materially decouples from reported profit for a sustained period.
At prices materially above base value without commensurate earnings upgrades, valuation itself remains a rejection gate.

catalysts: Net interest margin stabilizes or improves as deposit repricing offsets asset-yield pressure.
NPL ratio stays near current levels while provision coverage remains comfortably above required risk buffers.
Profit growth and retained earnings rebuild core Tier-1 capital faster than risk-weighted assets expand.
Sustainable shareholder distributions add to total return without weakening capital adequacy.
kill_thesis: Core Tier-1 capital continues to decline enough to constrain growth or distributions.
Provision coverage and asset-quality indicators deteriorate materially, especially if NPL formation accelerates.
Net interest margin compresses materially below the H1 level without fee or volume offsets.
Rapid balance-sheet growth produces weaker risk-adjusted returns or a material increase in credit concentration.

catalysts: 2026Q3 report expected 2026-10-31 confirms stable NIM and recurring earnings, without further retail credit migration.
Lower deposit costs continue to offset loan repricing and support net interest margin above 2025H1 1.21%.
Retail NPL formation stabilizes and provision coverage remains near or above 200%, preserving capital and payout capacity.
CET1 stabilizes above the H1 2026 11.25% level while sustainable ordinary-share dividends are approved and implemented.
kill_thesis: Retail credit deterioration continues: personal NPL rate rises materially above H1 2.02% or credit-card NPL above H1 3.80%, with higher loss formation and credit costs.
Group NPL ratio rises materially above 1.30% while provision coverage falls materially below H1 203.80%, impairing normalized ROE.
Net interest margin falls materially below H1 1.23% without fee, deposit-cost or cost-control offsets.
Core Tier-1 capital continues to decline from 11.25% or a new dilutive capital raise weakens ordinary-share returns.
Ordinary-share cash payout becomes unsustainable or materially below the 2026H1 proposed 31% payout.

catalysts: Overseas backlog converts to revenue while overseas gross margin remains structurally above mainland levels.
RMB840.82m Shouyi Medical repurchase consideration is collected on schedule and improves liquidity without new related-party leakage.
New-order growth re-accelerates, especially interior decoration and Middle East/Asia curtain-wall awards.
Operating cash flow improves materially as receivables and contract assets convert.
kill_thesis: Overseas project execution, FX, claims or collection issues erode the current margin advantage.
New orders and backlog conversion weaken enough to break the 2026-2027 earnings growth path.
Operating cash flow remains structurally negative while receivables/contract assets continue to expand.
The related-party repurchase is delayed, impaired, or replaced by value-destructive capital allocation.
Valuation remains above a high-teens normalized PE without a matching earnings upgrade.

catalysts: 2026Q3 report confirms stable or improving NIM without adverse credit migration.
Core Tier-1 capital ratio stabilizes or rebuilds while maintaining prudent credit growth.
Sustainable common dividends are approved and implemented without capital dilution.
Deposit funding costs fall faster than asset yields and fee income remains resilient.
kill_thesis: NPL formation and credit costs accelerate or provision coverage materially weakens.
Core Tier-1 capital falls persistently despite retained earnings, limiting dividends or growth.
Net interest margin resumes structural compression with no cost/fee offsets.
New capital issuance or regulatory requirements materially dilute common shareholder economics.

catalysts: Q2 gross/net margin improvement persists through H2 without inventory build accelerating.
Thailand/overseas capacity reaches utilization with acceptable ROIC and cash conversion.
Industry capacity digestion improves stainless processing spreads.
Operating cash flow catches up with earnings while inventory and debt normalize.
kill_thesis: Gross margin mean-reverts toward or below roughly 4.5% without a temporary explanation.
Inventory, short-term funding and receivables continue rising faster than revenue while CFO remains below earnings.
New governance or related-party/control issues materially raise capital-allocation risk.
Convertible/dilution or expansion capex reduces per-share returns without a commensurate ROIC improvement.

catalysts: 2026Q4及2027年订单和高毛利MIM、座椅调节机构业务收入兑现，扣非净利和现金流同步增长。
经营现金流在应收账款增速受控前提下覆盖CAPEX与现金分红。
价格回落至正式门槛且实际控制人关联主体减持结束、核心客户需求稳定。
kill_thesis: 汽车座椅零部件新项目未达目标、客户降价导致毛利率和扣非净利连续两个季度恶化。
应收账款与票据增长显著快于收入，CFO改善由暂时性营运资金释放驱动。
分红持续高于经营现金流减维持CAPEX，削弱研发和扩产资金。
实际控制人相关股东继续显著减持或出现治理、关联交易或客户集中度实质性恶化。

new_opportunities.kill_thesis: Reject D2 promotion if normalized fundamentals do not support the market signal or valuation eliminates the expected-return advantage.
Reject D2 promotion if balance-sheet, cash-conversion or normalized-return evidence does not support the defensive label.

catalysts: Sustained increase in passenger, aircraft and high-margin non-aeronautical revenue with recurring deducted profit growth.
Two or more quarters of stronger recurring ROE supported by cash generation after maintenance and lease obligations.
Transparent cash distribution and disciplined airport infrastructure capex improve shareholder economics.
kill_thesis: Recurring deducted profit fails to improve despite traffic recovery and higher reported revenue.
Material airport lease, concession or capital expenditure commitments erode owner-distributable cash.
Reported profit growth continues to depend on asset disposals, investment fair-value remeasurement or other nonrecurring items.
Adverse traffic, tariff regulation, retail concession or related-party cost changes reduce normalized returns.

catalysts: Two or more quarters of recurring revenue and deducted profit growth with rising normalized ROE.
Liquid-cooling customer orders and revenue are disclosed with meaningful commercial gross margin and cash conversion, rather than R&D/early promotion.
Receivable collection improves while operating cash flow after capex remains positive without reliance on working-capital timing.
Specialized industrial refrigeration and compressor businesses win profitable projects with stable repeat customers.
kill_thesis: Liquid-cooling revenue remains immaterial while the market capitalizes a full commercial scale-up.
Receivables continue rising despite flat or declining revenue, or new credit impairments consume cash and equity.
Normalized ROE remains below the required cost of equity and recurring profit continues to decline.
Cash flow recovery reverses or margin compression from input costs and competition persists.

catalysts: Additional creditworthy multi-year computing-service contracts materially increase contracted utilization beyond the initial RMB633m agreement.
Financing closes on terms that leave project-level ROIC and free cash flow clearly positive after interest, depreciation and maintenance capex.
Legacy property operations stop consuming cash and consolidated operating cash flow turns sustainably positive.
kill_thesis: Server utilization or customer expansion falls short, leaving material idle assets.
Financing cost, refinancing tenor or customer collection creates a cash-cycle mismatch.
Depreciation, impairment or operating costs cause the computing-power business to remain loss-making despite revenue growth.
Continued legacy losses or shareholder-funding dependence weakens liquidity further.

catalysts: High-quality toll-road asset acquisition/extension replaces the earnings lost from Changyong Expressway.
Core road traffic/profitability remains stable while low-margin trading does not dilute group ROIC further.
Cash payout is sustainably maintained or raised without balance-sheet or credit-risk migration.
Environmental/financial contingent exposures are resolved without material additional losses.
kill_thesis: Toll-road earnings structurally decline without credible replacement assets.
Trading revenue continues to dominate growth while margins, ROIC or deducted earnings weaken.
Financial/environmental exposures create material credit, guarantee or provision losses.
Dividend support increasingly relies on balance-sheet capacity rather than sustainable normalized earnings and cash flow.

catalysts: Hydrology normalizes and generation materially exceeds the weak H1 base.
Operating renewable projects with contracted economics move from optionality to attributable cash flow.
A durable earnings upgrade occurs without relying on thematic market narratives.
kill_thesis: Water inflows remain weak or generation falls below normalized assumptions.
Renewable project rights fail to reach construction/operation or returns are diluted by capex and financing costs.
The share price continues to discount unproven themes without a matching audited earnings step-up.
Regulatory or market-power pricing changes reduce normalized utility returns.

catalysts: 新品及渠道结构改善带来持续的销量增长、费用率下降和扣非利润恢复。
乌江智能化基地投资逐步转化为产能效率而非闲置资本。
价格回落至安全边际门槛，同时2026Q4现金转化和应收账款回款验证通过。
kill_thesis: 营收增长持续低于费用增长，扣非净利润连续季度下滑且正常化EPS跌破0.55元。
应收账款授信扩大后年末不能按公司披露的周期回收，现金流改善逆转。
新增基地CAPEX持续超过经营现金创造，资产回报率下降。
渠道变革或品牌竞争导致价格与毛利率长期下行。

catalysts: Online growth remains high-margin while direct-store productivity improves.
Inventory turns and impairment stabilize despite continued revenue growth.
New brands and licensed brands progress toward break-even without diluting core-brand ROIC.
Core-brand earnings compound faster than the valuation multiple compresses.
kill_thesis: Online growth proves promotional or materially lower quality than reported gross-margin economics imply.
Inventory and impairment grow persistently faster than revenue and cash earnings.
Multi-brand expansion consumes capital without a credible path to acceptable ROIC.
Core-brand growth slows materially while the equity remains priced above roughly 20x normalized earnings.

catalysts: Core Tier-1 capital ratio stabilizes and rebuilds without dilutive capital raising.
Net interest margin stabilizes as deposit repricing and asset mix improve.
Ordinary-share cash dividends resume at a sustainable payout level while asset quality remains stable.
kill_thesis: Core Tier-1 capital ratio moves materially closer to the regulatory floor or requires dilutive replenishment.
NIM continues to compress while ROE remains structurally below the cost of equity.
Asset-quality improvement reverses or ordinary-share payout remains structurally absent.

catalysts: Two consecutive quarters of core five-province sell-through and shipments normalizing without channel stuffing.
Non-core provinces maintain profitable double-digit expansion while incremental marketing spend produces positive incremental operating profit.
Gross-margin gains survive promotion competition and quarterly attributable earnings return sustainably positive.
Operating cash flow less maintenance capex remains positive without receivables or platform settlement deterioration.
kill_thesis: Core-province inventory/channel transition lasts beyond the planned normalization period or local brand share declines.
Selling expense ratio remains above 40% without corresponding revenue and normalized EBIT growth.
Further negative attributable quarters, persistent net working-capital consumption or increased receivable impairments.
Marketing spend and product innovation fail to deliver a defendable premium as channel price competition intensifies.

catalysts: Embedded-security pricing and gross margin recover on sustained bank/social-security-card replacement demand.
eSIM certifications convert into material commercial shipments with positive gross-margin contribution.
Digital-RMB related revenue becomes economically material rather than remaining below 5% of company revenue.
Deducted net profit turns sustainably positive and operating cash flow improves without further inventory or receivable absorption.
kill_thesis: Embedded-security revenue or gross margin remains under pressure and no durable core-volume/price recovery is visible.
Digital-RMB/eSIM theme activity fails to convert into material revenue and cash earnings.
Deducted earnings remain negative or weak while working capital continues to absorb cash.
Valuation continues to require sustainable profit materially above the company's 2022 historical peak before primary evidence supports such an earnings step-up.

catalysts: Verified sustained attributable operating profit and positive post-maintenance-capex owner cash flow, not merely receivable collection timing.
Reduction of leverage and related-party/guarantee exposure with transparent project-level cash distribution.
Successful asset disposals at or above independently verified recoverable value with meaningful debt reduction.
kill_thesis: Persistent attributable or deducted losses despite reported group profit.
CFO improvement fails to cover maintenance and growth capex or is primarily working-capital timing.
Credit impairments, project receivable recoverability or refinancing costs deteriorate.
Disposal of subsidiary equity leaves material residual guarantees or loss of cash-generating assets without adequate consideration.

catalysts: 连续至少两个季度主营收入、扣非利润和经营现金流同步改善，且回款优先项目形成可验证利润。
新产品或高毛利订单实现实质性收入及现金利润，而非仅有市场主题和股价趋势。
应收及合同资产周转显著改善，分红恢复且资本回报超过资金机会成本。
kill_thesis: 扣非持续亏损且现金流继续接近零或转负。
应收和合同资产减值进一步吞噬股东权益。
高估值继续依赖未经证实的转型预期，新增业务未形成经常性盈利。
资产管理收益或非经常性转回持续掩盖主营回报不足。

catalysts: Full-year revenue and normalized profit exceed the current recovery trajectory with positive operating cash conversion.
Inventory and debt decline while gross margin holds, proving recovery quality rather than only revenue growth.
Liquid-cooling products become a quantitatively disclosed, profitable business rather than an early-stage theme.
kill_thesis: Operating cash flow remains negative or materially below normalized profit.
Inventory, debt and finance costs continue to grow faster than sustainable earnings.
Liquid-cooling expectations continue to rerate the equity without material disclosed revenue, margin and cash contribution.
The 2026-2028 incentive thresholds are met through revenue growth without acceptable ROIC or free-cash-flow conversion.

catalysts: CCS and new-energy connector orders translate into high utilization and materially better incremental margins.
Signal-transmission and optical component margins stabilize while new-energy mix scales.
Operating cash flow grows faster than earnings despite the current expansion program.
kill_thesis: New-energy revenue grows without acceptable gross margin or return on invested capital.
Construction-in-progress and debt continue to rise ahead of utilization and free cash flow.
Core component margins deteriorate or customer concentration creates pricing pressure.
Convertible-bond-funded expansion dilutes returns without a matching normalized EPS uplift.

catalysts: Waste-processing and grid-power volumes continue growing without margin or collection deterioration.
The Changsha Hexi waste-to-energy project progresses at acceptable construction cost and expected ROIC.
H-share listing completes without materially dilutive economics for A-share holders.
Cash payout remains durable while leverage and interest burden stay controlled.
kill_thesis: Receivables and collection days worsen enough to break the current CFO-to-profit advantage.
H-share issuance or pricing materially dilutes A-share per-share value without a compensating ROIC uplift.
New-project capex and leverage grow faster than sustainable operating cash returns.
Tipping fees, tariffs or concession economics deteriorate materially.

catalysts: FDA import alert is formally removed and U.S. syringe shipments normalize.
Cambodia utilization ramps with stable gross margin and cash conversion.
Fenglin Medical integration turns profitable without further balance-sheet deterioration.
The new 18.01% shareholder relationship produces disclosed strategic or commercial synergies rather than remaining a financial ownership event.
kill_thesis: Import alert remains unresolved or expands in scope despite warning-letter remediation.
Deduct-net-profit margin fails to normalize despite revenue growth.
Inventory/capex/acquisition working capital absorbs cash faster than core profit grows.
Ownership-event expectations rerate the stock without evidence of incremental operating earnings or cash flow.

catalysts: Disclosed downstream AI-compute sales contracts or prepayments validate sell-through of GPU inventory.
H2 operating cash flow turns positive while inventory and receivables growth normalizes.
Short-term debt declines materially despite continued AI-compute revenue growth.
High-performance computing gross margin and company-level net margin improve enough to support materially higher normalized EPS.
kill_thesis: GPU procurement and inventory continue to expand without matching disclosed downstream demand or customer cash collection.
Operating cash flow remains deeply negative while short-term borrowing rises further.
High-performance computing gross margin falls materially below the current mid-teens level or Q3/Q4 profit conversion remains near break-even.
Receivables, inventory and financing costs grow faster than sustainable gross profit.

catalysts: Sugar/tomato gross margins remain above prior-year levels despite lower selling prices.
Operating cash flow remains positive and inventory discipline limits commodity-cycle cash absorption.
Domestic sugar supply/demand tightness supports processing and trading spreads.
kill_thesis: Sugar or tomato unit margins normalize sharply while the equity continues to price peak economics.
Inventory or hedging losses reverse the H1 cash-flow improvement.
Commodity prices and volumes weaken together, compressing both revenue and unit margin.

catalysts: 同控收购资产完成整合后归母每股现金盈利稳定、关联交易和资本开支可核验。
自产煤成本、煤电与运输协同改善，现金流减CAPEX持续覆盖股息与偿债。
A股价格回落至估值门槛同时煤价、归母现金流与组合能源集中度未恶化。
kill_thesis: 煤价持续下行导致正常化EPS跌破2.20元，煤炭分部现金利润与分红覆盖显著恶化。
并购后短借和在建项目资本开支抬升、现金分红不能由可分配现金持续覆盖。
新增煤制气项目CAPEX或关联交易使归母每股回报被摊薄。
煤炭长期需求和电力市场机制变化造成一体化ROIC长期低于资本成本。

catalysts: Sustained gas-sales margin and chemical-product profitability support normalized EPS despite a retreat from 2026 elevated oil prices.
Positive group operating cash after cash capex persists and dividends are supported by recurring, not windfall, cash generation.
Oil-price normalization lowers market valuation toward formal entry hurdle without a corresponding structural deterioration in asset quality.
Incremental integrated gas and storage returns prove attractive without an excessive capital spending cycle.
kill_thesis: Brent and realized oil prices normalize while recurring upstream cash margins fall below midcycle assumptions and group CFO cannot cover maintenance and committed growth capex.
Refining and marketing profitability structurally weakens due to fuel demand displacement, impairments or price-control pressure.
Material deterioration in group leverage, dividend coverage or minority-interest leakage reduces cash distributable to common shareholders.
A material increase in required capex or asset impairments undermines the modeled normalized common EPS range.

catalysts: 2026Q3 results confirm recurring earnings and NIM stability without deterioration in credit cost or CET1.
Lower deposit funding costs continue to offset loan repricing, sustaining NIM near or above H1 1.27%.
Overseas and cross-border banking franchise generates profitable fee and settlement growth without undue FX or geopolitical credit losses.
Common-share payout is approved and funded by sustainable earnings and regulatory capital headroom, not incremental dilutive equity.
kill_thesis: CET1 declines materially below H1 12.04% without a credible organic rebuild, or ordinary shareholders face another dilutive capital raise.
NPL ratio materially exceeds H1 1.22% or coverage falls materially below H1 200.85% as real-estate, retail or overseas credit costs accelerate.
NIM falls materially below H1 1.27% and recurring common ROE drops below the modeled 8%-9% range without a credible offset.
Credit impairment growth outpaces recurring pre-provision income, constraining distributable common earnings or dividends.
Material geopolitical, foreign-exchange or overseas credit losses impair the international franchise.

catalysts: High-value ship orders convert into deliveries at or above H1 margins.
New yard and engine capacity reaches high utilization without material cost overruns.
Normalized earnings or ROIC upgrades enough to offset the substantially higher market price.
Financing flexibility improves without debt, finance expense and capex outrunning sustainable free cash generation.
kill_thesis: Newbuild pricing or orders roll over before expanded capacity matures.
Delivery delays, cancellations, steel/FX pressure or mix deterioration compress normalized margin.
Debt, finance expense and capex continue to grow faster than sustainable free cash generation.

catalysts: Revenue growth accelerates materially while gross margin and operating efficiency continue to improve.
Normalized EPS moves clearly above the current bull-case path through durable customer demand rather than one-off working-capital effects.
ROE rises to a level consistent with the premium valuation without material balance-sheet expansion.
kill_thesis: Margin recovery stalls or reverses while the stock continues to trade at a premium multiple.
Operating cash flow normalization proves temporary and receivables or working capital again absorb cash.
End-market demand in motors, wind or new-energy applications weakens and volume growth fails to offset cost pressure.
The market continues to capitalize thematic expectations that are not visible in audited segment earnings.

catalysts: 高端药用玻璃产品由送样、验证和小批量供货转为可核验规模订单，并带来净利润与现金流同步提升。
连续多个季度扣非利润增速显著高于收入，毛利率恢复且销售费用增量取得正回报。
可转债转股后的每股盈利、净资产回报及分红能力稳定改善。
kill_thesis: 高端产品认证与客户转化迟缓，新增订单无法提升单位毛利。
天然气、硼砂、铝带等成本上升无法传导，扣非利润率持续低位。
转股摊薄与资本开支使每股盈利改善落空，现金流改善主要来自一次性营运资金释放。
高PB和高PE持续依赖市场情绪，正常化ROE仍明显低于资本成本。

catalysts: 铁路信号系统更新改造订单转化为连续两季度以上收入与扣非利润恢复，新签合同同比转正。
应收账款和合同资产回收、剔除财务公司吸收关联方存款后的经营现金流持续转正并覆盖资本开支和分红。
城轨与海外项目收入止跌，轨道交通高毛利核心设备占比提高并带动正常化ROE达到或超过资金成本。
kill_thesis: 剔除财务公司客户存款影响后的核心经营现金流持续为负，回款和合同资产减值恶化。
铁路/城轨订单持续下降且项目结算回款拖延，利润依赖非现金应计。
智能低空等新业务合同增长但绝对规模过小，不能对冲传统业务下滑。
正常化ROE长期低于股权资金成本且分红现金覆盖不足，PB溢价失去依据。

catalysts: Two consecutive quarters of sustained positive CFO with receivables growth below revenue growth and reduced overdue collection risk.
Recovery in core equipment orders translates into higher recurring margins and ROE, not just revenue rebound.
Material improvement in project delivery, customer collection and distributable free cash flow.
kill_thesis: Receivables and inventory continue rising while CFO stays negative despite accounting profits.
Normalized ROE remains below cost of equity and pricing/margins continue deteriorating.
Large customer credit impairment, related-party concentration or material deterioration in contract execution emerges.

catalysts: Comparable-basis core service revenue stabilizes and application/information-service growth reaccelerates.
AI/cloud/compute investments translate into measurable incremental profit and ROIC rather than only capex intensity.
Operating cash flow and free-cash-flow improvement persists through the second half.
Dividend growth remains intact while payout sustainability and balance-sheet strength are preserved.
kill_thesis: Comparable-basis core service revenue continues to contract without offsetting digital-service growth.
EBITDA decline persists while AI/cloud capex fails to generate acceptable returns.
Operating cash-flow improvement reverses materially.
Dividend policy or dividend-paying capacity is reduced materially.

catalysts: General automation orders and market share continue to grow as AI equipment investment and domestic substitution support demand.
Automotive power-system gross margin stabilizes or recovers after the H1 pressure.
Robotics, AIDC and digital-energy growth begins to contribute material profit rather than revenue only.
Q2 earnings recovery continues through H2 with better operating leverage.
kill_thesis: Core industrial automation growth falls materially below the market while servo/drive/PLC share declines.
Automotive power-system margin remains structurally depressed or worsens further.
Operating cash flow persistently lags recurring profit because receivables or inventory deteriorate.
Emerging businesses consume capital at returns materially below the core automation franchise without a credible path to improvement.

catalysts: Polyurethane global share and margins remain resilient as industry supply stays rational.
Ethane-feed and integrated petrochemical optimization sustain the H1 cost advantage.
High-end fine chemicals and new materials scale with acceptable incremental ROIC.
Capex transitions toward cash returns and deleveraging while the interim payout remains sustainable.
kill_thesis: H1 profit uplift proves mainly temporary global supply disruption and core chemical spreads normalize sharply.
Debt and finance costs keep rising while free cash flow materially lags reported earnings.
Large new capex projects deliver sub-hurdle utilization or ROIC.
Core polyurethane profitability erodes structurally rather than cyclically.

catalysts: High-value-added glass penetration continues to lift ASP and gross margin without sacrificing share.
Domestic auto demand stabilizes while new domestic capacity and U.S. production optimization support H2 shipment growth.
